tasks.label: BPA: 1 · Setup MCP server (read-only)
tasks.detail: Install/verify the powerbi-modeling MCP server and prerequisites (safe, no writes).

tasks.label: BPA: 2 · Setup MCP server (read-write)
tasks.detail: Same as setup, but registers the server in read-write mode (writes still prompt).

tasks.label: BPA: Show how to run a report
tasks.detail: Prints the exact @bpa-agent prompt to run (the analysis itself is agentic, not a shell command).
args: Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'To run a Best Practice Analysis:' -ForegroundColor Cyan; Write-Host '  1. Open the .pbix in Power BI Desktop (keep it open).'; Write-Host '  2. In Claude Code chat, connect:  Connect to ''${input:pbixName}'' in Power BI Desktop'; Write-Host '  3. Then ask the BPA agent:'; Write-Host ''; Write-Host '     @bpa-agent run the Best Practice Analyzer on "${input:pbixName}" using the ${input:ruleSet} rule set' -ForegroundColor Yellow; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'The report is written to output\<model>\<model>_<ruleset>_<timestamp>.html' -ForegroundColor Green

tasks.label: BPA: Render report from results.json
tasks.detail: Fill the HTML dashboard from a results JSON the agent produced (writes a timestamped report).

tasks.label: BPA: Open latest report
tasks.detail: Open the most recently generated report in your default browser.
args: $f = Get-ChildItem -Path '${workspaceFolder}/output' -Recurse -Filter *.html -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($f) { Write-Host "Opening $($f.FullName)" -ForegroundColor Green; Start-Process $f.FullName } else { Write-Host 'No reports found in output/ yet. Run a BPA analysis first.' -ForegroundColor Yellow }

tasks.label: BPA: Open workflow page
tasks.detail: Open the visual workflow diagram (docs/workflow.html) in your default browser.

tasks.label: Perf: Analyze Performance Analyzer export
tasks.detail: Parse a Performance Analyzer .json export, evaluate perf rules, and write a timestamped HTML dashboard.

tasks.label: Perf: Open workflow page
tasks.detail: Open the Performance Analyzer visual workflow (docs/perf-workflow.html).

tasks.label: Dashboard: Launch web app
tasks.detail: Start the main dashboard (Flask) at http://127.0.0.1:8000. Installs Flask if missing.
